body:
Please raise the proposed typing change in Discussions first; Rich asks for approval there before feature requests are filed as issues. `Table` currently passes non-string titles to `Console.render`, so `Rule` can work at runtime even though its annotation is narrower. The [tables docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst) describe `Table.grid` as a layout tool. A related report, #4171, was closed as not planned.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
